problem: Manual test lists silently omit new tests and a successful hardware artifact for a different scenario can be mistaken for required merge evidence.
invariant: Discover hosted test modules with non-empty execution evidence; run cheap checks before expensive jobs; require exact-revision scenario-specific proof at readiness, independently from hardware dispatch.
do_not_copy: RTX model or Landscape component count
failure_behavior: Missing tests, invalid classification, missing or inconsistent raw evidence, unknown world, expired artifacts or wrong producer fail closed. Draft deferral is never reported as measured PASS.
